status: Native XP window/display control integrated with proxy drawing; original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Load the absolute system32 DirectDraw module once, rejecting accidental self-load. Eagerly create a private native control object using the original or extended factory. Delegate window cooperative levels, physical modes and restoration through the matching version1/2/3/4/7 interface; query cooperative state through the native7 view used by the public4/7 entry points. Pixels, storage, draws and presents stay in the WebGPU frontend. No native D3D rendering delegation.

Hold proxy lifetime across synchronous native window callbacks; never hold object/transport locks across native factory or control calls. Roll back native validation errors. Complete outer native cooperative state after nested activation callbacks, matching the original Wine contract. Keep existing virtual-mode fallback for E_NOTIMPL/UNSUPPORTEDMODE; no unsupported-mode waiver. Native module remains held until process exit.

Native display-mode metadata is queried when physical; virtual metadata retains its existing local path. Synchronize mode dimensions/depth before primary allocation and after normal/restore transitions. Preserve requested refresh for existing pacing paths. Release native control at public-reference zero; legacy private storage can outlive public ownership. Clear the retired primary display identity and physical-mode flag, so delayed private destruction cannot restore the display mode of a later owner.

Entering EXCLUSIVE from NORMAL marks existing video-memory surfaces lost, excluding system/managed storage. IsLost, Lock and attachment queries expose loss; Restore also recovers the implicit flip chain, leaving independent depth attachments lost; RestoreAllSurfaces clears all cooperative loss without discarding the shadow storage. This is not an implementation claim for physical mode/focus loss or native primary WRONGMODE restoration.

nativeReference.scope: 132-second original XP system DLL reference, zero proxy wire batches. Three hidden/visible/NOWINDOWCHANGES cases capture geometry/style/procedure/focus, synchronous selected messages, mode/redundant-mode/NORMAL/restore/release and independent app-local/native module coexistence. RAM-only writes.
nativeReference.limits: Raw primary loss and WRONGMODE results retained as unresolved; they are not waived or falsely asserted as implemented.

nativeControlLifetime.scope: 133-second independent system-DLL run: DD1/2 release returns0 and immediately restores the original WndProc; a contender can enter exclusive even though the old primary pointer is still held (the original Wine source describes destruction of legacy surfaces; the probe deliberately never calls the old primary pointer after public zero, so no invalid-pointer access or deallocation behavior is independently probed). DD4/7 release returns1 and preserves the WndProc/exclusive ownership until primary release. All26 return results and4 reference/procedure records retained. No proxy wire batches, RAM-only writes.

additionalZOrderNotifications: EVENT case=0 name=normal index=6 message=0047 wp=00000000 xy=0,0 size=800,600 flags=00001813 after=000500FE screen=800,600

contractValidator.basis: Frozen original ddraw_ddraw7.c test_proc consumes expected messages only when their message matches; other notifications are allowed. Additional resizing, flags, activation, wrong phases, special z-order values, duplicates, missing or reordered required messages are rejected by the local comparator controls.

proxyWindowComparison.scope: Same immutable source with only the final DLL loader redirected to the app-local audited proxy; transformed producer saved and hashed. Compare24 exact HWND snapshots,68 mandatory selected messages in order and21 control results. Proxy emits69 selected messages, including one additional no-move/no-size/no-activation z-order completion immediately after its corresponding request. Exact selected-message equality is false and is explicitly retained, not presented as a native variant: all three native runs have68 messages. Like the original Wine test_proc, require the expected messages in order; permit only this tightly checked additional completion, retaining geometry/style/procedure/focus snapshots and all other notification payload/order checks. Normalize only per-step trace indices and non-special insert-after HWND identities; style-change fields and HWND_BOTTOM remain exact. The same probe also redirects the immutable lifetime source to the app-local proxy and compares all4 release/procedure records and26 control results. Simulated transport replies, not a GPU pixel acceptance. Three primary Restore return values and15 raw surface observations intentionally retained as unresolved, outside the window-control comparison.

rejectedInitialAudits.reason: DD1/2 legacy surfaces retain private proxy storage but do not pin the public draw reference. Retaining native control until private zero incorrectly kept exclusive ownership after public release and blocked later tests. Independent native1/2/4/7 lifetime probe confirms the correction.

Missing video-surface loss let an expected-failure attachment query acquire an unbalanced reference and retain native exclusive ownership; later primary creation failed and upstream code dereferenced its failed result.

Restoring the front buffer alone left implicit flip children lost, so the next original attachment query failed and was dereferenced by upstream. Restore now recovers the complete flip allocation while leaving independently attached depth storage lost.

Private lifetime correction exposed real native nested SetCooperativeLevel semantics. An outer EXCLUSIVE call completes despite recursive NORMAL; preserving the inner flags rejected a valid flip primary and upstream dereferenced its failed result.
